function listPosts({url,$}) {return {posts:$("article header a[href*=\"/posts/\"]").map((i,e)=>({url:$(e).attr('href'),title:$(e).text().trim()})).get(),next:null};}
function parsePost({url,$}) {const b=$(".article-content").first().clone();b.find('script,style,nav,header,footer,aside,.comments,#comments,.related-posts,.post-footer,.post-share').remove();const t=$("main h1").first();return {title:t.attr('content')||t.text().trim(),bodyHtml:b.html()||'',author:$('meta[name="author"]').attr('content')||$('[rel="author"]').first().text()||null,publishedAt:$('meta[property="article:published_time"]').attr('content')||$('time[datetime]').first().attr('datetime')||null,tags:[]};}
scraper.notes: 實際讀取公開列表與文章 https://yuncolorblog.com/posts/%E7%94%9F%E6%B4%BB%E6%97%A5%E5%B8%B8/removing-ropes-from-a-canyoning-route/；正文 .article-content，標題 main h1。
